method: Rechecked the governing regulations and dated catalogue progression before reconsidering the finished course selections, actual workbook descriptions and terminology. Same AI, with a separate source-first pass.
findings: The one-major degree totals 180 EC. Two 60 EC compulsory years lead to the minor, restricted approved electives and research project. With first-year completion and 120 EC, the academic threshold for the approved project is met.

The molecular option retains direct biology and biochemistry and substantive microbiological laboratory work, with quantitative methods to study data. The second keeps biological substance while adding a quantitative modelling and digital image-analysis sequence. None of these mathematical or computing courses supplies the physical instruments or structural-imaging methods described by Groningen.

The newly selected biodiversity course gives organismal context and microscopy. The two schedules pass formal offerings and prerequisites. Separate unmatched cells and the caution presentation preserve the gaps in chemistry, physics, instrumentation and the required project.
